title: The Name on the Tip of the Tongue

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART V (81-100, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager has spent all morning trying to remember the name of a neighbor's noisy pet bird from long ago.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been trying all morning to remember the name of the noisy pet bird a neighbor kept when (subject.he/she) was little. It was a big green bird. It shrieked every morning. It bit (subject) once on the ear. And its name is completely, infuriatingly gone.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) offers suggestions all through lunch. "Squawk? Greenie? Biter?" None of them are right, although (subject) admits "Biter" would have suited it. The two of them come up with a list of thirty names, and (subject) is still sure it was none of them.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) gives up and goes back to work. Hours later, halfway through hauling water, (subject.he/she) stops dead and shouts "MANGO!" Several villagers jump. (subject) doesn't explain. (subject.He/She) just goes on hauling water, looking enormously relieved.
